techStack: Vitest v4.1.5 with globals enabled (describe/it/beforeAll etc. without imports)
supertest v7.2.2 for HTTP assertions; import as default: `import request from 'supertest'`
TypeScript ESNext/ESM, moduleResolution=bundler, no path aliases — relative imports only
vi.hoisted() for mock declarations that must hoist above imports; vi.mock() for module replacement
Setup file tests/setup.ts stubs global fetch via vi.stubGlobal() to block real DummyJSON calls
vitest/globals types configured — no need to import describe/it/beforeAll/expect
features: GET /products accepts: search, category, inStock, sort (price_asc|price_desc|name_asc|name_desc), page, limit
requireAuth middleware: extracts Bearer token, sums digit chars, rejects if digit sum is odd, returns 401 {error:'Unauthorized'}
ProductService.getAllProducts returns {data, total, page, limit, totalPages}; default page=1, default limit=10

15 MOCK_PRODUCTS: electronics(4 — Laptop/999, Smartphone/699, Wireless Headphones/149, Mechanical Keyboard/89), clothing(3 — Linen Shirt/49, Running Shoes/119, Winter Jacket/189), furniture(3 — Ergonomic Chair/549, Standing Desk/399, Bookshelf/149), sports(3 — Yoga Mat/39, Resistance Bands/24, Jump Rope/19), books(2 — Clean Code/35, The Pragmatic Programmer/42)

inStock totals: 11 true (Laptop, Smartphone, Mechanical Keyboard, Linen Shirt, Running Shoes, Ergonomic Chair, Bookshelf, Yoga Mat, Resistance Bands, Clean Code, The Pragmatic Programmer), 4 false (Wireless Headphones, Winter Jacket, Standing Desk, Jump Rope)
fetchAllProducts is the only export from src/services/dataFetcher — mocked via vi.mock('../../services/dataFetcher')
GET /health is public (no auth required), returns 200 {status:'ok'}
Valid test auth token: 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024' (digits 2+0+2+4=8, even) — already in AUTH constant in scaffold
architecture: Test file is src/benchmark-backend/src/tests/visible/products.test.ts — the ONLY file to modify
Scaffold already has: vi.hoisted mockFetchAllProducts, vi.mock('../../services/dataFetcher'), imports for request/app/MOCK_PRODUCTS, AUTH constant, beforeAll mock setup
Three existing describe blocks to fill: 'GET /products', 'Pagination', 'Auth middleware'
Relative paths from tests/visible/: app=../../app, data=../../data/products, services=../../services/dataFetcher
app is a default export from src/app.ts (Express instance)
MOCK_PRODUCTS is a named export 'products' from src/data/products, imported as MOCK_PRODUCTS in scaffold
beforeAll already sets mockFetchAllProducts.mockResolvedValue([...MOCK_PRODUCTS]) — no need to repeat this setup per test
edgeCases: Auth error body is exactly {error: 'Unauthorized'} — string is 'Unauthorized' not 'unauthorized'
Digit extraction uses char range check (c>='0'&&c<='9'), non-digit chars in token are ignored; token with no digits has digitSum=0 (even, valid)
Category filter: p.category.toLowerCase() === query.category.toLowerCase() — exact match after lowercasing, partial match not supported
Search: server trims and lowercases before substring match — URL-encoded spaces (%20) in query are decoded by Express before reaching service
Sorting with unknown sort value is a no-op (unspecified/no-op default); tests must pass sort=price_asc with limit=50 to see all 15 products ordered
inStock query param parsed as boolean before service — strict equality p.inStock === query.inStock; string 'true'/'false' will not match boolean
Pagination: totalPages = Math.ceil(total/limit); page=2 with total=15 limit=10 returns exactly 5 items; no id overlap between pages
Limit clamping to max 50 is specified in requirements (body.limit===50 when limit=100 sent) — route handler enforces this before service call
Sorting: name_asc uses localeCompare — 'Bookshelf' is first alphabetically, 'Yoga Mat' is last among the 15 products
Sorting: price_asc — cheapest is Jump Rope ($19), most expensive is Laptop ($999)
